newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian grain harvest pace surpasses last year's.
newsitem.headline: Russian grain harvest pace surpasses last year's.

text.p: Russia's grain harvest is gaining pace, with 7.36 million hectares brought in as of July 19 compared with 7.12 million at this time last year, an Agriculture Ministry official said on Monday.

Ivan Gridasov, head of the ministry's crops-growing section, was quoted by Interfax news agency as saying wheat yields were up to 2.72 tonnes per hectare, a rise of 0.22 tonnes on year-ago levels. The best yields had come from the Krasnodar region, where per hectare yields topped 3.69 tonnes.
Russia has forecast its 1997 grain crop flat at at least 70 million tonnes, but some officials say net output may rise to 75-80 million tonnes.
